name: Dyogrammaton
source:
2005 A.D., Tokyo. Monsters have appeared, destroying any human traces indiscriminately. As a counter-measure, a special intercepting force called DAKT was created.
This is the story of these urban fighting robot units.
translation:
公元2005年，东京。怪物出现后，不分对象地摧毁着一切人类存在过的痕迹。作为应对措施，一支名为DAKT的特殊截击部队应运而生。
这是关于这些城市战斗机器人部队的故事。
